title: Job Search, Wages, and Inflation
title_zh: 求职、工资与通货膨胀
title_primary: 求职、工资与通货膨胀
title_secondary: Job Search, Wages, and Inflation
authors: Pilossoph, Laura, Ryngaert, Jane M.
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: How do inflation expectations affect the job search behavior of workers when wages are set in nominal terms? A canonical job search model incorporating nominal wage rigidities predicts that on-the-job search should increase with expected inflation. Using novel survey questions, we show that workers are more likely to search at higher values of hypothetical inflation. In the Survey of Consumer Expectations, within-respondent variation in inflation expectations predicts on-the-job search.

title: States as Financiers: International Lending in War and Peace
title_zh: 国家作为金融家：战争与和平中的国际借贷
title_primary: 国家作为金融家：战争与和平中的国际借贷
title_secondary: States as Financiers: International Lending in War and Peace
authors: Sebastian Horn, Carmen Reinhart, Christoph Trebesch
official: 官方在线 2026-05-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: States are major international financiers, but their role is poorly understood. We study state-driven cross-border lending over two centuries using a new database covering 1.2 million official loans and grants by 134 governments and 70 multilateral institutions since 1790. We document a dual, state-contingent structure of international credit. In normal times, private creditors dominate cross-border lending. In adverse states of the world, such as wars and financial crises, official creditors step in, at times on a massive scale. These official flows are driven by great powers, are highly subsidized, and are largely absent from canonical models in international macroeconomics.
abstract_zh: 国家是主要的国际金融参与者，但其角色却鲜为人知。我们利用一个涵盖自1790年以来134个政府和70个多边机构发放的120万笔官方贷款与赠款的新数据库，研究了过去两个世纪由国家驱动的跨境贷款。我们记录了国际信贷的双重、依国家状态而定的结构。在正常时期，私人债权人主导跨境贷款。而在世界处于不利状态时，如战争和金融危机，官方债权人会介入，有时规模巨大。这些官方资金流动由大国驱动，补贴程度高，且在国际宏观经济学的经典模型中基本缺失。

title: Beyond the early era of EVs: Evidence from the staggered rollout of the HOV lane network in California
title_zh: 超越电动汽车早期时代：来自加州HOV车道网络分阶段推出的证据
title_primary: 超越电动汽车早期时代：来自加州HOV车道网络分阶段推出的证据
title_secondary: Beyond the early era of EVs: Evidence from the staggered rollout of the HOV lane network in California
authors: Eric Avis, Jing Li, Katalin Springel
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 官方在线 2026-08-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Local policies like high-occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane exemptions play an important role in encouraging electric vehicle (EV) adoption, a key component of climate programs. Using tract-level vehicle registrations and detailed data on HOV lane openings from 2012 to 2024, we study the causal effect of HOV policies on EV adoption in California. We find that HOV exemptions significantly increased EV uptake, with effects that were stronger in later years as EV technology and markets advanced. The impact is also greater in more congested areas with longer commutes and concentrated in higher-income tracts, highlighting both the effectiveness and distributional implications of HOV incentives.
abstract_zh: 地方性政策如高占用率车辆（HOV）车道豁免在鼓励电动汽车（EV）采用方面发挥着重要作用，这是气候项目的关键组成部分。利用2012年至2024年间的人口普查区级车辆注册数据及HOV车道开放的详细资料，我们研究了HOV政策对加利福尼亚州电动汽车采用的因果效应。研究发现，HOV豁免显著促进了电动汽车的普及，且随着电动汽车技术和市场的进步，这一效应在后期年份更为显著。此外，该影响在交通拥堵更严重、通勤时间更长的地区更为突出，并集中于高收入区域，这既凸显了HOV激励措施的有效性，也揭示了其分配效应。

title: A review of collective agri-environmental schemes using a human–AI framework
title_zh: 基于人机协同框架的集体农业环境计划述评
title_primary: 基于人机协同框架的集体农业环境计划述评
title_secondary: A review of collective agri-environmental schemes using a human–AI framework
authors: Robert Huber, Sara Ammann, Claudia Bethwell, Caitriona Carlin, Viviane Fahrni 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We systematically review collective agri-environmental schemes that support landscape stewardship in agriculture. We analyze 96 case studies across OECD countries based on 73 peer-reviewed articles. To guide this review, we develop a framework based on policy dimensions, the policy cycle, and micro-level implementation dimensions. This framework provides a basis for defining evaluation criteria and for assessing how these schemes are designed. The review combines the analytical power of artificial intelligence with expert domain knowledge. The synthesis of both enables a comprehensive examination of policy and implementation dimensions, resulting in critical insights into the schemes’ designs and functioning, and their broader applicability. Our results describe patterns of design and implementation in the reviewed literature, without establishing a causal link between the design and implementation of schemes and ecological outcomes. We find considerable heterogeneity among schemes indicating flexibility for decision-makers to adapt schemes to specific environmental targets at local scale, but that there is still significant room to enhance the role of farmers as key players in collective agri-environmental schemes. By integrating human expertise with the capabilities of large language models, our approach exemplifies how to balance and mitigate the limitations of each, increasing the transparency of the review process.
abstract_zh: 我们系统性地回顾了支持农业景观管理的集体农业环境计划。基于73篇同行评审文章，我们分析了OECD国家中的96个案例研究。为引导本综述，我们构建了一个基于政策维度、政策周期及微观实施维度的分析框架。该框架为定义评估标准和评估这些计划的设计方式提供了基础。本综述结合了人工智能的分析能力与专家领域知识，两者的综合运用使得对政策与实施维度进行全面审视成为可能，从而对计划的设计、运作及其更广泛的适用性提出关键见解。我们的结果描述了所回顾文献中的设计与实施模式，但并未建立计划设计与实施同生态结果之间的因果联系。我们发现各计划间存在显著异质性，表明决策者可根据地方尺度的具体环境目标灵活调整计划，但在增强农民作为集体农业环境计划关键参与者的作用方面仍有显著提升空间。通过将人类专业知识与大型语言模型的能力相结合，我们的方法展示了如何平衡并减轻各自的局限性，从而提高综述过程的透明度。

title: In Search of a Spatial Equilibrium in the Developing World
title_zh: 探索发展中国家的空间均衡
title_primary: 探索发展中国家的空间均衡
title_secondary: In Search of a Spatial Equilibrium in the Developing World
authors: Douglas Gollin, Martina Kirchberger, David Lagakos, Diogo Britto, Clément Imbert 等
official: 官方在线 2017-06-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper, we draw on new high-resolution evidence to document how amenities vary across space within twenty developing countries. We focus on measures of health, housing quality, crime and pollution. These vary substantially across space, and they can be carefully measured with highly comparable data. We find that in almost all countries, and for almost all measures, amenities are constant or increasing in population density. In addition, net internal migration flows are directed toward denser areas in every country. These findings are hard to reconcile with a spatial equilibrium. Instead, they suggest that developing countries are undergoing a reallocation of workers to densely populated areas, which offer higher living standards on average.
abstract_zh: 本文利用新的高分辨率证据，记录了二十个发展中国家中便利设施在空间上的分布差异。我们重点关注健康、住房质量、犯罪和污染等方面的指标。这些指标在空间上差异显著，且可通过高度可比的数据进行精确测量。我们发现，在几乎所有国家及几乎所有指标中，便利设施随人口密度保持恒定或呈增加趋势。此外，每个国家的净内部迁移流均指向人口更密集的地区。这些发现难以与空间均衡理论相协调。相反，它们表明发展中国家正经历劳动力向人口密集区域重新配置的过程，这些区域平均而言提供了更高的生活水平。

title: The impact of fiscal decentralization on under-five mortality: evidence from China
title_zh: 财政分权对五岁以下儿童死亡率的影响：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 财政分权对五岁以下儿童死亡率的影响：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: The impact of fiscal decentralization on under-five mortality: evidence from China
authors: Weijun Lu, Jinzi Liu, Yunqing Su, Ziyi Jin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper exploits a quasi-natural experiment provided by China’s Province-Managing-County (PMC) fiscal reform to examine the impact of fiscal decentralization on under-five mortality. Using a county-level panel dataset from 1999 to 2012 matched with county-level under-five mortality data, we employ a staggered DID design to identify the health effect of fiscal decentralization. The results show that the PMC fiscal reform significantly increased county-level under-five mortality, an increase of approximately 1.02–1.51 deaths per 1,000 live births. The reduction in the provision of public healthcare services and increases in air pollution are two potential channels through which the reform adversely affects under-five mortality. The adverse effect can be strengthened by fiscal pressures,legal transparency and political promotion incentives of local officials. KEYWORDS: Fiscal decentralization healthcare under-five mortality JEL CLASSIFICATION: H75 H77 I18
abstract_zh: 本文利用中国省直管县财政改革所提供的准自然实验，考察了财政分权对五岁以下儿童死亡率的影响。基于1999年至2012年的县级面板数据，并匹配县级五岁以下儿童死亡率数据，我们采用交错双重差分设计来识别财政分权的健康效应。研究结果显示，省直管县财政改革显著提高了县级五岁以下儿童死亡率，每千例活产婴儿中死亡人数增加约1.02至1.51人。公共卫生服务供给的减少以及空气污染的加剧，是改革对五岁以下儿童死亡率产生不利影响的两条潜在渠道。财政压力、法律透明度以及地方官员的政治晋升激励会强化这一不利影响。关键词：财政分权；医疗卫生；五岁以下儿童死亡率 JEL分类号：H75 H77 I18

title: When cointegration misleads: regional evidence on the determinants of housing prices in China
title_zh: 当协整误导：中国房价决定因素的区域证据
title_primary: 当协整误导：中国房价决定因素的区域证据
title_secondary: When cointegration misleads: regional evidence on the determinants of housing prices in China
authors: Liping Gao, Ghislain Gueye, Hyeongwoo Kim, Jisoo Son
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using data from 29 regional housing markets in China, this study examines the long-run relationships between housing prices and key macroeconomic variables. Conventional cointegration methods can be misleading, as estimated coefficients often contradict standard demand–supply theory even when statistical tests indicate cointegration. Among the variables, only real income consistently explains regional housing price dynamics, whereas real interest rates and building costs fail to do so consistently across markets. Region-specific models reveal substantial heterogeneity and are both statistically robust and economically meaningful. Panel cointegration tests that account for cross-sectional dependence fail to detect cointegration when such heterogeneity is ignored. These findings highlight the limitations of uniform national approaches and underscore the need for tailored, region-specific housing policies. KEYWORDS: Housing market cointegration dynamic ordinary least squares panel cointegration test with CSD disaggregated regional data JEL CLASSIFICATION: R30 E00 C51
abstract_zh: 本研究利用中国29个区域住房市场的数据，探讨了房价与关键宏观经济变量之间的长期关系。传统的协整方法可能产生误导，因为即便统计检验表明存在协整，估计系数也常常与标准供需理论相悖。在各类变量中，仅实际收入能一致地解释区域房价动态，而实际利率和建筑成本则无法在各市场间保持一致的解释力。区域特定模型揭示了显著的异质性，既在统计上稳健，又在经济上具有意义。当忽略这种异质性时，考虑横截面依赖性的面板协整检验未能检测到协整关系。这些发现凸显了统一全国性方法的局限性，并强调了制定针对性的区域住房政策的必要性。关键词：住房市场协整 动态普通最小二乘法 考虑横截面依赖性的面板协整检验 分类区域数据 JEL分类：R30 E00 C51

title: From legitimization to structured legalization: A governance framework from Türkiye’s 2018 zoning amnesty
title_zh: 从合法化到结构化法治：土耳其2018年区划特赦的治理框架
title_primary: 从合法化到结构化法治：土耳其2018年区划特赦的治理框架
title_secondary: From legitimization to structured legalization: A governance framework from Türkiye’s 2018 zoning amnesty
authors: Orhan Ercan, Orhan Mataracı, Ümit Gedik, Erdem Ercan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Informality remains one of the most persistent challenges for land governance, particularly where large-scale legalization policies seek to reconcile existing development with formal planning and regulatory systems. Although zoning amnesties often generate comprehensive administrative records of informal development, they rarely establish institutional mechanisms capable of transforming legitimization into sustainable legalization. This study examines the implementation outcomes of Türkiye's 2018 Zoning Amnesty and evaluates how they provide the foundation for a governance model for structured legalization. An integrated analytical framework combining spatial assessment, institutional analysis, and policy evaluation was applied using national administrative statistics, orthophoto-based spatial analysis, municipal inventories, zoning-amnesty datasets, and evidence from the environmentally sensitive Uzungöl case study. The findings demonstrate that the Building Registration Certificate functioned primarily as an instrument of institutional legitimization rather than complete legalization, creating a nationwide administrative inventory while leaving critical planning, technical, environmental, and legal issues unresolved. Building on these findings, the study proposes a governance model that transforms administrative legitimization into structured legalization through a sequential institutional pathway integrating legal verification, spatial assessment, technical and environmental assessment, and administrative integration. The proposed model offers a transferable approach for more transparent, adaptive, and risk-informed land governance in countries facing similar challenges of large-scale informality.
abstract_zh: 非正规性仍然是土地治理中最持久的挑战之一，尤其是在大规模合法化政策试图将现有发展与正式规划和监管体系相协调的情况下。尽管分区特赦常常产生非正规发展的全面行政记录，但它们很少建立能够将合法化转化为可持续法律化的制度机制。本研究考察了土耳其2018年分区特赦的实施结果，并评估了它们如何为结构化合法化的治理模式奠定基础。采用结合空间评估、制度分析和政策评估的综合分析框架，利用国家行政统计、基于正射影像的空间分析、市政清单、分区特赦数据集以及环境敏感的乌宗格尔案例研究证据。研究结果表明，建筑登记证书主要作为制度合法化的工具而非完全法律化，在全国范围内建立了行政清单，同时留下了关键的规划、技术、环境和法律问题未解决。基于这些发现，研究提出了一种治理模式，通过整合法律验证、空间评估、技术和环境评估以及行政整合的序列化制度路径，将行政合法化转化为结构化法律化。所提出的模式为面临类似大规模非正规性挑战的国家提供了一种可转移的方法，以实现更透明、适应性强和风险知情的土地治理。

title: Agency incentives and disparate revenue collection: Evidence from Chicago parking tickets
title_zh: 代理激励与差异化税收征管：来自芝加哥停车罚单的证据
title_primary: 代理激励与差异化税收征管：来自芝加哥停车罚单的证据
title_secondary: Agency incentives and disparate revenue collection: Evidence from Chicago parking tickets
authors: Elizabeth Luh, Benjamin Pyle, James Reeves
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We leverage a sharp 2012 parking fine increase for failing to purchase vehicle registration to examine disparate ticketing patterns across enforcement agencies in Chicago. Using an event-study framework, we find that Chicago police increased their enforcement of car registration non-compliance in Black relative to non-Black neighborhoods, with no observed disparate response from non-police enforcement agencies. This disparity is unexplained by compliance and is instead driven by departmental revenue incentives and multitasking-driven lower marginal search costs in Black neighborhoods. Disparate enforcement also exacerbated existing gaps in financial instability, generating increased rates of ticket non-payment and bankruptcy filings in Black neighborhoods.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2012年芝加哥对未购买车辆注册的停车罚款大幅上调这一事件，考察不同执法机构间开罚单模式的差异。通过事件研究框架，我们发现芝加哥警方在黑人相对非黑人社区加强了对车辆注册违规的执法力度，而非警方执法机构则未表现出类似的差异化反应。这种差异无法用合规性解释，而是源于部门收入激励及多任务处理导致的在黑人社区较低的边际搜索成本。差异化执法还加剧了既有的财务不稳定差距，导致黑人社区罚单未支付率和破产申请率上升。

title: Monopsony Makes It Big
title_zh: 买方垄断做大
title_primary: 买方垄断做大
title_secondary: Monopsony Makes It Big
authors: Caldwell, Sydnee, Dube, Arindrajit, Naidu, Suresh
official: 来源期次 Journal of Economic Literature · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: The literature on imperfect competition in labor markets has expanded rapidly in recent years. This article provides a guide to the field, focusing on the firm-specific (“residual”) labor supply elasticity as the definition of a firm’s labor market power. We present a general framework showing how this elasticity nests the three widely studied sources of monopsony power: search frictions, preference heterogeneity, and employer concentration. We summarize the empirical estimates of the elasticity of labor supply, highlighting sources of possible heterogeneity. We emphasize that it is difficult to infer elasticities from markdowns (and vice versa) due to the diversity of firm wage-setting practices, illustrating this point using the interaction between monopsony and efficiency wages. We discuss how policy issues in antitrust, labor market regulation, immigration, and macroeconomics interact with monopsony and conclude by listing several areas for future research.
abstract_zh: 近年来，关于劳动力市场不完全竞争的文献迅速增长。本文为该领域提供指南，聚焦于企业特定（“剩余”）劳动力供给弹性作为企业劳动力市场势力的定义。我们提出一个通用框架，展示该弹性如何涵盖三种被广泛研究的买方垄断势力来源：搜索摩擦、偏好异质性和雇主集中度。我们总结了劳动力供给弹性的实证估计，强调可能存在的异质性来源。我们指出，由于企业工资制定实践的多样性，难以从工资加价中推断弹性（反之亦然），并通过买方垄断与效率工资的相互作用阐明这一观点。我们讨论了反垄断、劳动力市场监管、移民和宏观经济学中的政策问题如何与买方垄断相互影响，最后列出未来研究的若干方向。

title: Pension Income and Post-Retirement Labor Supply
title_zh: 养老金收入与退休后劳动供给
title_primary: 养老金收入与退休后劳动供给
title_secondary: Pension Income and Post-Retirement Labor Supply
authors: Fabian Kindermann, Carla Krolage, Sebastian Kunz, Manuel Pannier, Karoline Ströhlein
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper provides causal evidence on how pension income affects labor supply after retirement. We exploit the introduction of the German Earned Income Pension Credit (Grundrente), which permanently increased pension income for retirees with long contribution histories and comparatively low lifetime earnings. The reform generates exogenous variation in non-labor income without creating additional labor supply distortions, allowing us to isolate pure income effects. Using administrative data covering the universe of German retirees and a difference-in-differences design, we find that a 1, 200 euro increase in annual pension income reduces unconditional labor earnings by approximately 122 euros, implying a marginal propensity to earn out of unearned income of −0.1. Two thirds of this response reflects extensive margin adjustments, which operate through both increased exit and reduced re-entry, with the remainder driven by intensive margin reductions. Effects are stronger for younger, more labor-market-attached cohorts.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于养老金收入如何影响退休后劳动供给的因果证据。我们利用德国收入型养老金补贴（Grundrente）的引入，该改革永久性地提高了具有较长缴费历史且终身收入相对较低的退休人员的养老金收入。这一改革在非劳动收入中产生了外生变动，而未造成额外的劳动供给扭曲，使我们能够分离出纯粹的收入效应。利用覆盖德国全体退休人员的行政数据以及双重差分设计，我们发现年度养老金收入增加1200欧元会使无条件劳动收入减少约122欧元，这意味着非劳动收入的边际赚取倾向为-0.1。这一反应的三分之二来自集约边际调整，其通过增加退出和减少重新进入两种途径发挥作用，其余部分则由集约边际减少驱动。效应在更年轻、劳动市场依附性更强的群体中更为显著。

title: Detecting Favoritism in Public Procurement
title_zh: 检测公共采购中的偏袒行为
title_primary: 检测公共采购中的偏袒行为
title_secondary: Detecting Favoritism in Public Procurement
authors: Joosua Virtanen, Janne Tukiainen, Susmita Baulia
official: 官方在线 2026-07-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Favoritism as a mode of corruption is a major concern in public procurement (PP) in many countries. We propose a regression discontinuity design (RDD) test arguing that the winning history of marginal winners and losers can be used to detect favoritism. We apply the empirical test to PP of cleaning services in Finland and find evidence of favoritism even in this relatively low corruption environment. First, winners of close races in terms of win margin tend to have won more also in the past, which is in contrast to competitive environment. Second, to rule out an alternative explanation of collusion based on incumbency, we show that these winners also tend to submit their bids the last, indicating information sharing about rival bids from the buyer to the favored bidder.

abstract: Two facts distinctively separate exporter dynamics from firm dynamics. One is the strikingly low survival rate of new entrants into export markets. The second is that new entrants survive less than re-entrants. We argue that these two facts are particularly useful to discipline exporter dynamics models because many sources of firm heterogeneity (e.g. fixed costs) do not affect survival rates when firms time their entry decision optimally. We extend a standard exporter dynamics model by positing that firms experiment to resolve an uncertain component in foreign-market profitability. We estimate the model using customs data from Peru. Despite its parsimony, having only four relevant parameters, the model matches the survival profile of new entrants and re-entrants. It is also sufficiently rich to deliver predictions about many exporter dynamics facts highlighted in the literature. Finally, we exploit variation across products and markets to provide additional evidence supporting the model’s experimentation mechanism.

abstract: This paper shows that effective reskilling substantially reduces antidepressant use among injured workers and their partners. abstract: We introduce a fully nonparametric estimator to estimate willingness to pay (WTP) using contingent valuation (CV) data. Traditional methods such as the probit model are used because of their roots in utility theory as well as their ease to implement. However, they are limited by their reliance on strict parametric assumptions, such as linearity and the requirement that the researcher pre‐select important covariates. While these methods are widely used, they may fail to capture complex relationships, particularly in situations involving nonlinearity or interactions among variables. This paper introduces Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART) as a flexible, nonparametric way to estimate WTP from CV studies. Using a simulation study, we demonstrate that BART is competitive with traditional models under strict data‐generating assumptions. When the underlying data‐generating process is more complex, BART outperforms traditional models and even other machine‐learning models. Moreover, BART automatically incorporates individual heterogeneity into estimation, making it more informative than traditional nonparametric estimators. We illustrate the breadth of the model's benefits with an empirical application estimating WTP to develop an Invasive Species Rapid Response Fund in the Hawaiian Islands. We find WTP distributional differences along the margins of gender, age, and income. We also construct willingness to pay curves out of Monte Carlo Markov Chain (MCMC) draws and calculate posterior means and credible intervals using empirical cumulative distribution functions (CDFs). We find these WTP to be lower than those from the probit. Future natural extensions of BART make this method a compelling alternative for estimating WTP in CV experiments.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种完全非参数估计方法，利用条件价值评估（CV）数据来估计支付意愿（WTP）。传统方法如probit模型因其植根于效用理论且易于实施而被广泛使用。然而，这些方法受限于严格的参数假设，例如线性关系以及研究者需预先选择重要协变量的要求。尽管这些方法应用广泛，但在涉及非线性或变量间交互作用的复杂情境中，可能无法捕捉真实关系。本文引入贝叶斯加性回归树（BART）作为一种灵活的非参数方法，用于从CV研究中估计WTP。通过模拟研究，我们证明在严格的数据生成假设下，BART与传统模型表现相当。当底层数据生成过程更为复杂时，BART优于传统模型甚至其他机器学习模型。此外，BART自动将个体异质性纳入估计，使其比传统非参数估计器更具信息量。我们通过一项实证应用展示了该模型的广泛优势，该应用估计了夏威夷群岛建立入侵物种快速响应基金的支付意愿。研究发现，WTP在性别、年龄和收入边际上存在分布差异。我们还利用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）抽样构建了支付意愿曲线，并通过经验累积分布函数（CDFs）计算后验均值和可信区间。结果显示，这些WTP估计值低于probit模型的结果。BART未来的自然扩展使其成为CV实验中估计WTP的有力替代方法。

abstract: Governments around the world need internal discipline to ensure the implementation of policies and delivery of governance outputs, and this need is more severe in authoritarian systems that govern top-down and without bottom-up electoral pressures. Conventional wisdom suggests that autocrats rely on punishment to discipline subordinates who fail to obey orders, but we argue that public disclosure of such malfeasance can also be effective, even when unaccompanied by punishment. In the case of internal misinformation—the tampering of government data and statistics by local agents to distort central authorities’ decisions—we find that the Chinese government successfully adopted public disclosure to combat the manipulation of local GDP numbers by lower-level governments. Our evidence indicates that publicly disclosing a prior act of falsification reduced future manipulation and did so at various levels of local governments, even as officials implicated by the disclosure faced no career setbacks. Hinting at downstream impacts, such disclosure also improved confidence among economic actors, evidenced by increased business activity in localities involved in public disclosures.
abstract_zh: 世界各国的政府都需要内部纪律以确保政策执行和治理成果的交付，而在那些自上而下治理、缺乏自下而上选举压力的威权体制中，这种需求更为迫切。传统观点认为，威权者依赖惩罚来约束不服从命令的下属，但我们主张，公开披露此类不当行为同样有效，即便没有伴随惩罚。以内部虚假信息为例——即地方代理人为扭曲中央决策而篡改政府数据和统计——我们发现中国政府成功采用了公开披露的方式来打击下级政府对地方GDP数据的操纵。我们的证据表明，公开披露先前的造假行为减少了未来的操纵，且这一效果在各级地方政府中均有所体现，即使被披露涉及的官员并未遭遇职业挫折。此外，此类披露还产生了下游影响，提升了经济参与者的信心，表现为涉及公开披露地区的商业活动增加。

abstract: We examine how state policies requiring firms to facilitate workplace retirement saving affect household balance sheets. abstract: Small towns constitute most of Africa’s urban settlements, yet their spatial dynamics remain poorly understood in relation to demographic change, land-use efficiency, and social inclusion. Existing decoupling models overlook initial land-consumption conditions, path dependence, and broader urban subsystem behavior. This study examines 98 small towns in Burkina Faso through five analyses: growth trajectory clustering, Gibrat’s law testing, land-population elasticity modeling, a benchmark-adjusted Tapio decoupling framework, and social outcome assessment. Results reveal sustained urban growth with two accelerated built-up expansion waves (1995–2000 and 2015–2019), reflecting decentralization policies, real-estate liberalization, and conflict-induced internal displacement. Four persistent growth regimes emerge, reflecting administrative status, accessibility, metropolitan influence, and local socioeconomic conditions. Population growth is largely size-independent, while the population-built-up relationship progressively converges toward proportionality (β = 0.96), indicating increasing spatial-demographic coherence. Persistent outliers highlight the influence of conflict, migration, mining activity, and geographic isolation. Against Burkina Faso’s national benchmark of 75 m² per capita, the share of towns exhibiting inefficient land expansion increased from 40% (2005–2010) to 78% (2015–2019). Although some land-use efficiency indicators are statistically associated with poverty incidence, they explain no meaningful share of the observed variation in poverty and wealth inequality. Context-aware efficiency classes show no significant relationship with either indicator. These results suggest that compliance with land-use benchmarks does not automatically translate into social inclusion. By integrating demographic, spatial, institutional, and social dimensions, this study proposes a replicable framework for diagnosing urban expansion in data-scarce regions and highlights the need for context-sensitive, governance-aware land-use policies in rapidly urbanizing small-town systems.

title_primary: 社会可见性与转移支付需求：来自低收入群体的实验证据
title_secondary: Social observability and demand for transfers: Experimental evidence from a low income population
authors: Marcel Fafchamps, Fadela Sadou Zouleya
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine how social observability affects the willingness of low-income individuals to apply for financial support. After completing tasks to earn income in the lab, participants are given the opportunity to apply for a transfer from a social fund earmarked for the lowest earners. We experimentally vary whether the application is public or private and whether the funds come from the experimenters or other participants. We find that making the application public reduces take-up by 31 percentage points. Adding peer funding leads to a further 10 percentage point drop. These effects are strongest when income is earned through effort instead of a lottery, and when both public visibility and peer funding are present. The findings are not driven by altruistic or redistributive preferences, but perspective taking makes participants more sensitive to the public application treatment. Our findings suggest that ensuring privacy in the application process helps increase access to income support programs.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了社会可见性如何影响低收入个体申请经济支持的意愿。在实验室中完成赚取收入的任务后，参与者有机会申请从一项专为最低收入者设立的社会基金中获得转移支付。我们通过实验变化申请是公开还是私密，以及资金来源是实验者还是其他参与者。我们发现，将申请公开化会使参与率下降31个百分点。增加同伴资助则导致进一步下降10个百分点。这些效应在收入通过努力而非抽签获得时最为显著，并且当公开可见性与同伴资助同时存在时效果最强。这些发现并非由利他或再分配偏好驱动，但换位思考使参与者对公开申请处理更为敏感。我们的结果表明，确保申请过程中的隐私有助于增加收入支持项目的可及性。

title: Local and spillover effects of trade on structural transformation: Evidence from Brazil
title_zh: 贸易对结构转型的地方与溢出效应：来自巴西的证据
title_primary: 贸易对结构转型的地方与溢出效应：来自巴西的证据
title_secondary: Local and spillover effects of trade on structural transformation: Evidence from Brazil
authors: Mateo Hoyos, José Alejandro Coronado, Guilherme Klein Martins
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-06-02 · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of trade liberalization on structural transformation, using quasi-experimental tariff reductions from Brazil's 1990s reforms. Building on recent cross-regional macroeconomic literature, we extend the traditional shift-share framework to estimate both local and spatial spillover effects on sectoral employment shares, providing insights on aggregate outcomes. Regions more exposed to tariff cuts saw declines in manufacturing employment, increases in the primary sector, and reductions in non-tradables. Spillover effects—mediated through migration or proximity—partially offset local deindustrialization in manufacturing but amplified declines in non-tradables. These effects persisted for over twenty years and proved robust to alternative explanations, including competing structural transformation hypotheses and other economic shocks during the period of analysis. Overall, our findings support theories highlighting comparative advantage as a potential driver of trade-induced structural transformation.
abstract_zh: 本文利用巴西1990年代改革中准实验性的关税削减，研究了贸易自由化对结构转型的影响。基于近期跨区域宏观经济文献，我们扩展了传统的转移-份额框架，以估计关税削减对部门就业份额的本地效应和空间溢出效应，从而揭示总体经济结果。关税削减暴露程度更高的地区经历了制造业就业下降、初级部门扩张以及非贸易部门收缩。通过移民或地理邻近性传导的溢出效应，部分抵消了制造业的本地去工业化，但加剧了非贸易部门的收缩。这些效应持续了二十多年，并在替代性解释（包括分析期间的其他经济冲击及竞争性结构转型假说）下依然稳健。总体而言，我们的研究结果支持了强调比较优势作为贸易驱动型结构转型潜在驱动力的理论。

title: Banking concentration and loan-rate markups in a frictional loan market
title_zh: 摩擦性贷款市场中的银行集中度与贷款利率加成
title_primary: 摩擦性贷款市场中的银行集中度与贷款利率加成
title_secondary: Banking concentration and loan-rate markups in a frictional loan market
authors: Mei Dong, Stella HuangFu, Timothy Kam, Sam Ng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We present a model of frictional lending where entrepreneurs choose their outside options (self-finance or waiting to find other lenders) when bargaining with banks. When the number of banks is sufficiently small, the equilibrium features self-finance as entrepreneurs’ dominant outside option; when the number of banks is sufficiently large, waiting becomes the dominant outside option. The model can rationalize the mixed empirical evidence on the relationship between banking concentration and loan-rate markups. It also uncovers new policy-dependent channels through which the concentration-markup relationship need not be stable or positive. Depending on the equilibrium regime, monetary policy can alter entrepreneurs’ outside options and change how banking concentration affects loan market power. Our main insight extends to cases with endogenous entry of banks or entrepreneurs, prudential regulation, and default risk.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个摩擦性贷款模型，其中企业家在与银行谈判时选择其外部选项（自我融资或等待寻找其他贷款人）。当银行数量足够少时，均衡特征表现为自我融资成为企业家的主导外部选项；当银行数量足够多时，等待则成为主导外部选项。该模型能够解释关于银行集中度与贷款利率加成之间关系的混合经验证据。它还揭示了新的政策依赖渠道，通过这些渠道，集中度与加成之间的关系可能不稳定或非正相关。根据均衡机制的不同，货币政策可以改变企业家的外部选项，并影响银行集中度如何作用于贷款市场力量。我们的主要见解扩展至银行或企业家的内生进入、审慎监管以及违约风险等情形。

title: Politeness as an economic signal in C2C markets: evidence from Korea and Japan
title_zh: C2C市场中礼貌作为经济信号：来自韩国和日本的证据
title_primary: C2C市场中礼貌作为经济信号：来自韩国和日本的证据
title_secondary: Politeness as an economic signal in C2C markets: evidence from Korea and Japan
authors: Yaejin You
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines the economic effects of seller communication in consumer-to-consumer (C2C) markets, focusing on linguistic politeness as a trust-building signal. Using 18,264 listings from a single C2C platform operating as ‘Daangn’ in Korea and ‘Karrot’ in Japan, we construct a politeness index for each item description with a multilingual NLP model. Logistic and linear regression models are then used to quantify, first, how politeness affects the likelihood that a potential buyer initiates a chat, and second, how politeness varies with listing price across countries. The results show that politeness significantly increases chat initiation in both markets, but the marginal effect is almost 2.5 times larger in Japan than in Korea. We also find a negative relationship between price and politeness, indicating that sellers replace polite, affective language with more direct, information-centric descriptions for higher-priced goods, with this ‘strategic directness’ again being stronger in Japan. Overall, the findings demonstrate that communication style is an economically meaningful and culturally contingent signal in C2C markets, and they quantify the economic value of politeness on digital platforms.

title: Berge equilibria – an algebraic approach
title_zh: 伯格均衡——一种代数方法
title_primary: 伯格均衡——一种代数方法
title_secondary: Berge equilibria – an algebraic approach
authors: Frank Riedel, Maria-Laura Torrente
official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Berge equilibrium offers an alternative to Nash equilibrium in game theory, emphasizing cooperative stability rather than individual optimization. Despite recent interest, a systematic study of Berge equilibria in finite normal form games is still lacking, with fundamental questions like existence remaining open. This paper characterizes Berge equilibria through a polynomial system of equations, enabling computational algebra and algebraic geometry methods to analyze them. Algorithms based on Gröbner bases determine the existence and computation of Berge equilibria. Furthermore, we show that the set of games admitting completely mixed Berge equilibria is contained within a determinantal variety, whose dimension we explicitly bound from above.
abstract_zh: 伯格均衡为博弈论中的纳什均衡提供了一种替代方案，强调合作稳定性而非个体最优化。尽管近期研究兴趣渐增，但有限正规型博弈中伯格均衡的系统性研究仍显不足，诸如存在性等基本问题尚未解决。本文通过多项式方程组刻画伯格均衡，从而能够运用计算代数和代数几何方法对其进行分析。基于格罗布纳基的算法可判定伯格均衡的存在性并实现其计算。此外，我们证明存在完全混合伯格均衡的博弈集合包含于某一行列式簇中，并给出了该簇维数的显式上界。

title: Universalism: an 11‐year longitudinal study
title_zh: 普遍主义：一项11年纵向研究
title_primary: 普遍主义：一项11年纵向研究
title_secondary: Universalism: an 11‐year longitudinal study
authors: Christine Bangum, Benny Geys, Rune Sørensen
official: 官方在线 2026-05-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How individuals make trade‐offs between socially proximate or distant groups impacts upon a wide range of social, political and economic behaviours. This paper exploits Norwegian administrative register data over the 2012–2022 period to assess whether, and if so how, such ‘(moral) universalism’ develops as individuals age and go through major life events. We show that ageing is associated with increases in universalism in early adulthood and declining universalism among older individuals, but the magnitude of these changes remains very small. Similarly, major life events—such as starting higher education, first‐time parenthood, positive income shocks and retirement—are linked to at best minor and short‐lived changes in universalism. These results add important insights regarding the (in)stability of individuals' value orientations during adulthood, and raise new questions about the potential influence of broader social forces on universalism across cohorts.
abstract_zh: 个体如何在社交亲近或疏远群体之间进行权衡，会影响广泛的社会、政治和经济行为。本文利用挪威2012-2022年期间的行政登记数据，评估这种“（道德）普遍主义”是否会随年龄增长及经历重大人生事件而发生变化，以及如何变化。我们发现，年龄增长与成年早期普遍主义的上升及老年个体普遍主义的下降相关，但这些变化的幅度非常微小。同样，重大人生事件——如开始接受高等教育、首次成为父母、正向收入冲击及退休——最多仅与普遍主义的微小且短暂变化相关。这些结果为了解成年期个体价值取向的（不）稳定性提供了重要见解，并引发了关于更广泛社会力量对不同世代普遍主义潜在影响的新问题。

title: Dynamics of market power in monetary economies
title_zh: 货币经济中市场势力的动态变化
title_primary: 货币经济中市场势力的动态变化
title_secondary: Dynamics of market power in monetary economies
authors: Jyotsana Kala, Lucie Lebeau, Lu Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the dynamic interplay between monetary policy and market power in a decentralized monetary economy. Building on Choi and Rocheteau (2024), our key innovation is to model rent seeking as a process that takes time, allowing market power to evolve gradually. Our model predicts that a gradual reduction in the nominal interest rate causes a simultaneous increase in rent-seeking effort and producers’ market power, consistent with the stylized correlation observed in the US over the last few decades. Free producer entry can however reverse this relation in the short run, and neutralize it in the long run. Indeterminacy and hysteresis emerge when consumers benefit from valuable outside options, with short-run monetary policy shocks potentially locking the economy into high- or low-market-power equilibria in the long run. These dynamics are robust to alternative environments, including dividend-paying real assets, access to banking, and a customer-capital interpretation of rent-seeking, highlighting monetary policy’s persistent and state-dependent effects on market structure through endogenous rent formation.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个分散化货币经济中货币政策与市场势力之间的动态相互作用。基于Choi和Rocheteau（2024）的研究，我们的关键创新在于将寻租行为建模为一个需要时间的过程，从而使市场势力能够逐步演变。我们的模型预测，名义利率的逐步降低会导致寻租努力和生产者市场势力同时增加，这与美国过去几十年来观察到的典型相关性一致。然而，自由生产者进入在短期内可能逆转这一关系，并在长期内使其中性化。当消费者受益于有价值的外部选择时，会出现不确定性和滞后现象，短期货币政策冲击可能将经济锁定在长期的高或低市场势力均衡中。这些动态在替代环境下依然稳健，包括支付股息的实际资产、银行服务的获取以及寻租的客户资本解释，突显了货币政策通过内生租金形成对市场结构产生的持久且状态依赖的影响。

title: Has the maturity premium attenuated over time?
title_zh: 期限溢价是否随时间衰减？
title_primary: 期限溢价是否随时间衰减？
title_secondary: Has the maturity premium attenuated over time?
authors: Yi-Ting He, Po-Chao Huang, Kuan-Cheng Ko, Wen-Chi Lo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The maturity premium, a newly proposed anomaly, characterizes higher returns of stocks adopting more long-term debt. Motivated by the stylized facts of declines in the use and dispersion in long-term debt for the U.S. companies, we hypothesize that the maturity premium has attenuated in recent periods. Applying Bai and Perron’s (1998) structural-change test, we detect one structural break at June 2000. The abnormal maturity premium is significant before this date but becomes insignificant afterwards. Our results are robust to different factor models and the concentration of the smallest firms.
abstract_zh: 期限溢价，作为一种新提出的异象，描述了采用更多长期债务的股票获得更高回报的现象。鉴于美国公司长期债务使用减少及其分布分散化的典型事实，我们假设期限溢价在近期已有所减弱。运用Bai和Perron（1998）的结构变化检验，我们检测到2000年6月存在一个结构断点。在此日期之前，异常期限溢价显著，而之后则不再显著。我们的结果在不同因子模型及最小公司集中度下均保持稳健。

title: Chat over coffee? Diffusion of agronomic practices and market spillovers in Rwanda
title_zh: 咖啡闲聊？卢旺达农业技术扩散与市场溢出效应
title_primary: 咖啡闲聊？卢旺达农业技术扩散与市场溢出效应
title_secondary: Chat over coffee? Diffusion of agronomic practices and market spillovers in Rwanda
authors: Esther Duflo, Daniel Keniston, Tavneet Suri, Céline Zipfel
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Agricultural extension programs often train a subset of farmers and rely on social networks for knowledge dissemination. We evaluate this approach through a two-stage experiment of an agronomy training program among Rwandan coffee farmers. The first stage randomized trainee concentration at the village level; the second randomly selected participants within villages. The program increased knowledge and self-reported adoption of the taught practices. It also reshaped farmers’ social networks by creating new social ties primarily among co-trainees. At first glance, the intervention appeared modestly effective, with treated farmers exhibiting higher yields than control applicants within the same village, although this difference is not statistically significant. However, knowledge did not diffuse, and control farmers with more treatment friends at baseline reduced audited adoption and input use. Villages with high trainee concentrations showed suggestive evidence of negative spillovers, consistent with reallocation of labor and other shared inputs toward treated farmers, as formalized in a simple model in which social ties shape access to inputs. Relative declines in the yields of control farmers in these villages account for treatment-control differences, raising concerns both about this dissemination strategy and estimates that fail to consider potential negative spillovers.
abstract_zh: 农业推广项目通常培训一部分农民，并依赖社会网络进行知识传播。我们通过一项针对卢旺达咖啡农的农艺培训项目的两阶段实验来评估这一方法。第一阶段在村庄层面随机分配受训者集中度；第二阶段在村庄内随机选择参与者。该项目提高了知识水平及对所教授实践的自报采纳率。同时，它还通过主要在同批受训者之间建立新的社会联系，重塑了农民的社会网络。乍一看，该干预措施似乎效果适中，受训农民在同一村庄内的产量高于对照组申请者，尽管这一差异在统计上并不显著。然而，知识并未扩散，且基线时拥有更多受训朋友的对照组农民减少了经审计的采纳行为和投入品使用。受训者集中度高的村庄显示出负面溢出效应的初步证据，这与劳动力和其它共享投入品向受训农民重新分配的现象一致，正如一个简单模型所形式化的那样，该模型认为社会联系影响投入品的获取。在这些村庄中，对照组农民产量的相对下降解释了处理组与对照组之间的差异，这既对这种传播策略提出了质疑，也对那些未能考虑潜在负面溢出效应的估计提出了担忧。

title: Smartphone Bans, Student Outcomes and Mental Health
title_zh: 智能手机禁令、学生学业成果与心理健康
title_primary: 智能手机禁令、学生学业成果与心理健康
title_secondary: Smartphone Bans, Student Outcomes and Mental Health
authors: Sara Abrahamsson, Maria Zhu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The rapid rise in smartphone use among youth has raised concerns about its effects on well-being and learning. Using administrative and survey data with an event-study design, I show that banning smartphones in middle schools has no average effect on education or mental health but masks important gender differences. Bans reduce psychological health care use among girls, lower bullying for both genders, and improve girls’ GPAs and academic track placement, especially among those from disadvantaged backgrounds. These results suggest smartphone bans can be a low-cost policy to improve outcomes, particularly for girls.
abstract_zh: 青少年智能手机使用的迅速增加引发了对其福祉和学习影响的担忧。利用行政与调查数据，并采用事件研究设计，我发现中学禁止智能手机对教育或心理健康平均无影响，但掩盖了重要的性别差异。禁令减少了女孩的心理健康护理使用，降低了双方的欺凌现象，并提升了女孩的GPA及学术轨道安置，尤其对来自弱势背景的学生效果显著。这些结果表明，智能手机禁令可作为一种低成本政策来改善结果，特别是对女孩而言。

title: Understanding the Drivers of Housing Prices: Fundamental versus Expectational View
title_zh: 理解房价驱动因素：基本面与预期视角
title_primary: 理解房价驱动因素：基本面与预期视角
title_secondary: Understanding the Drivers of Housing Prices: Fundamental versus Expectational View
authors: CLEMENTE PINILLA‐TORREMOCHA
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-02-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper empirically confronts two different channels driving the 2000s boom‐bust and the recent strong appreciation of house prices in Europe. The first channel, the fundamental view, is characterized by income and credit. While the expectational view is based on the expectations of households and construction firms. I propose a Panel Factor Augmented Vector Autoregressive (FAVAR) model that can determine these views' importance. First, the results show that expectations play a significant role in short‐ and medium‐run fluctuations of house prices, explaining 30% and 20%, respectively. Second, the effect of a household's belief shock on house prices depends on the level of mortgage credit liberalization. Specifically, in countries with looser credit conditions, household beliefs significantly impact house prices. While in countries with tighter credit conditions, the impact is not significant. Overall, this research provides new evidence that credit market conditions can influence the effect of expectations on house prices.
abstract_zh: 本文通过实证分析，对比了推动2000年代房地产繁荣与衰退以及近期欧洲房价强劲上涨的两种不同机制。第一种机制，即基本面观点，以收入和信贷为特征；而预期观点则基于家庭和建筑企业的预期。我提出了一种面板因子增强向量自回归（FAVAR）模型，用以确定这两种观点的重要性。首先，结果显示，预期在房价的短期和中长期波动中扮演重要角色，分别解释了30%和20%的波动。其次，家庭信念冲击对房价的影响取决于抵押贷款信贷自由化的程度。具体而言，在信贷条件较为宽松的国家，家庭信念对房价有显著影响；而在信贷条件较为严格的国家，这种影响则不显著。总体而言，本研究提供了新的证据，表明信贷市场条件能够影响预期对房价的作用。

title: Internal migration and labor share: Theory and evidence
title_zh: 内部迁移与劳动份额：理论与证据
title_primary: 内部迁移与劳动份额：理论与证据
title_secondary: Internal migration and labor share: Theory and evidence
authors: Yang Yang, Qi Yu, Junsen Zhang, Kang Zhou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the effect of internal migration on firms’ labor share. We develop a theoretical framework in which rural-to-urban migration increases the labor share of local firms by substituting labor for capital and increasing the skill wage premium. Using a “shift-share” instrumental variable approach, we show that migration inflows increase the labor share of local firms in China. To test the mechanisms predicted by the model, we show that migration inflows reduce capital per worker, raising the relative wages of skilled labor while lowering the skill composition of firm employment. Finally, heterogeneity analysis reveals that the effect is more pronounced among private firms and highly educated migrants, with no significant gender differences.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了内部迁移对企业劳动份额的影响。我们构建了一个理论框架，其中农村向城市的迁移通过以劳动替代资本并提高技能工资溢价，增加了本地企业的劳动份额。采用“转移-份额”工具变量方法，我们表明迁移流入提高了中国本地企业的劳动份额。为检验模型预测的机制，我们发现迁移流入降低了人均资本，提高了技能劳动力的相对工资，同时降低了企业就业的技能构成。最后，异质性分析显示，这一效应在私营企业和高学历迁移者中更为显著，且不存在显著的性别差异。

title: Investigating the Suitability of Managed Aquifer Recharge Legislation Across Australia and Lessons for Reducing Barriers
title_zh: 澳大利亚管理型含水层补给立法的适用性调查及减少障碍的经验教训
title_primary: 澳大利亚管理型含水层补给立法的适用性调查及减少障碍的经验教训
title_secondary: Investigating the Suitability of Managed Aquifer Recharge Legislation Across Australia and Lessons for Reducing Barriers
authors: Constantin Seidl, Sarah Ann Wheeler, Declan Page, Kurt Schwabe

abstract: ABSTRACT Given increases in climate change and surface water overallocation pressures in the future, groundwater will play an increasingly important role for water supply. This requires greater investment in water security, with the nature‐based water management tool of managed aquifer recharge (MAR) a cost‐effective alternative to more conventional choices such as dams or desalination. While MAR is a mature and safe technology that has been used for decades around the world, currently there is a lack of private and public sector investment in MAR in Australia. The main barriers to MAR implementation are not hydrogeological, but legislation and policy. Our study investigates MAR policy issues further by undertaking a thematic legislative analysis of 252 Australian state and territory water and environmental legislation and policy documents and conducting a focus group/interview discussion with state/territory MAR policy experts ( n = 18). The legislative review finds that Australian MAR legislation is highly complex, providing no ownership of recovery water nor security from government opportunism, and leads to high regulatory costs, disincentivising private sector investment. The study concludes by providing targeted recommendations to reduce implementation barriers and regulatory and transaction costs through reducing regulatory risk, strengthening property rights, improving regulatory processes and providing better education and guidance.
abstract_zh: 摘要 鉴于未来气候变化及地表水过度分配压力的加剧，地下水在水资源供应中将扮演日益重要的角色。这要求加大对水安全的投资，而基于自然的水管理工具——含水层人工补给（MAR）相较于大坝或海水淡化等传统选择，是一种成本效益更高的替代方案。尽管MAR是一项成熟且安全的技术，已在全球范围内应用数十年，但目前澳大利亚在MAR方面的私人和公共部门投资仍显不足。MAR实施的主要障碍并非水文地质条件，而是立法与政策层面。本研究通过对252项澳大利亚州和领地水资源及环境立法与政策文件进行主题性立法分析，并与州/领地MAR政策专家（n=18）开展焦点小组/访谈讨论，进一步探讨MAR政策问题。立法审查发现，澳大利亚的MAR立法高度复杂，既未明确回收水的所有权，也未提供防范政府机会主义行为的保障，且导致高昂的监管成本，从而抑制了私人部门的投资积极性。研究最后提出了针对性建议，旨在通过降低监管风险、强化产权、改进监管流程及提供更好的教育与指导，减少实施障碍及监管和交易成本。

title: Portugal's Empire in Africa and Asia, 1415-1975

abstract: Portugal’s empire began with the conquest of Ceuta (1415) and lasted until the decolonization process (1974-1975). Portugal, therefore, both led the first wave of Western colonization and became the last to relinquish its empire during the twentieth century. Concentrating on the African and Asian dimensions of Portugal's empire, I offer a comparison with other European empires, summarizing relevant events and chronologies. Issues covered include openness ver-sus protection, slavery and slave trading, the role of early colonial settlers, and the empire's impact on both the metropolitan economy and the regions that were colonized.
abstract_zh: 葡萄牙帝国的历史始于1415年征服休达，直至1974-1975年的非殖民化进程。因此，葡萄牙既是西方殖民浪潮的引领者，也是20世纪最后一个放弃帝国的殖民国家。本文聚焦葡萄牙帝国在非洲和亚洲的维度，通过与其他欧洲帝国的比较，梳理相关历史事件与时间脉络。研究议题涵盖开放与保护主义、奴隶制与奴隶贸易、早期殖民定居者的作用，以及帝国对宗主国经济与殖民地区域的双重影响。
